pages.body:
A new era of mystic divine energy is unfolding, pervading every
part of the Earth.
May this sacred energy bless each and every one.
Wishing you all a very happy and blessed New Year.
May you remain at the mystic, divine, holy feet of the Supreme
Divine Nature
May the whole earth, created by the Holy Mystic Master, bless
every soul to awaken and realign their path from the illusions of
Maya toward the realization of Oneness. Sri Swamiji prays that
this New Year brings blessings to all. May the Lord’s mystic
energy, present in every corner of the world, guide all souls to the
Holy feet of the Master.

pages.title: New Year 2026 — page 3
pages.alt: New Year 2026, inside right, page 3
pages.body:
Let 2026 be a year dedicated to giving and sharing rather than
extracting. See the Divine in every form—the great and the small,
the rich and the poor, the wise and the simple. Recognize the
One present in all, and experience for yourself the beauty of the
Omnipotent Mystic Energy. When you compare only to
understand (and never to conquer), and when you choose
kindness and forgiveness, the Mystic will respond to you in kind.
Together, we can nurture the beautiful world God has created.
Every small act of help, every gentle correction, and every extra
touch of care heals you as much as it heals others. Feel the pain
of another before you speak or act; if an unkind word hurts you,
know that it hurts them equally. Therefore, restrain from causing
harm in word or deed. Enjoy every comfort, every meal, and every
friendship by first asking if you have earned it through humility.
Let this life never be 'a gift carelessly spent.' 
This life is a lease from the Divine; respect
and care for it deeply. Make the best use
of the precious gift of Time. Once lost, it
never returns. 
Only your good deeds remain, leaving a
lasting influence on the world. Spend
your time responsibly and with love.
With Blessings
       -Sri Swamiji
With Blessings
       -Sri Swamiji

pages.title: Guru Purnima · Divine Sandesa 2024 — page 2
pages.alt: Guru Purnima · Divine Sandesa 2024, inside left, page 2
pages.body:
Sri Guru means Swamiji Deeksha Guru Srimad Abhinava Sachidananda
Swamiji of Dwaraka Peeth Paschimaamnyaya Thathvamasi.
Sri Maha Guru means Adi Shankara’s incarnation of Sri Datta Guru.
Sri Sri Sri Guru means Lord Badarinarayan, with Lord Sri Krishna.
Maharshi Vedavyasa is seen as a great master who taught people to
find their inner selves through outer experiences. He encouraged
overcoming of negative thoughts and strengthening the body to
connect with the inner world. Maharshi Vedavyasa, like a good
dedicated lawyer, stressed the importance of following one's duty
which is our Dharma. If someone strays from this duty, it is behaving
like a corrupt selfish lawyer, who seeks personal praise and gain,
instead of doing what is right.
When faced with illusions (Maya), it is important to recognize and
remedy the illusions and avoid taking the wrong path. For example,
those of us who have a good amount of money should also spend it for
charity and helping others. This will stop them from using it in a bad way.
Remember, having enough money also means having enough energy.

pages.body:

Don’t become a Wheel of Life
We should First Be Linked to our Actions,

and then Abandon those Links.
and then Abandon those Links.
In our lifetime, Nature is Sampada. Swamiji
always says “Samayame, Samadaanam,
Samaadaaname, Samayam”. Time is Wealth,
Knowledge, Relationship, God, Job, Karma, etc.
Mind is a Guide, Adviser, Teacher, and Guru. Mind
manipulates us and the Mind also motivates us.
That is why Mind should be controlled and it is
best done by Dhyana. Because the mind likes to
play freely as a monkey; we must always stabilise
the Mind.
Time is always in a steady excellent flow. Who wants to fight against
time? To such a person, time becomes a challenge. Which one is great,
Time or Manassu (mind)? This answer is difficult, but the answer
depends on Manassu. The mind creates many miracles. Mind is God.
Mind is the way. The Mind shows us how to lead a peaceful life; yet the
Mind must be in our control. Nature is great. Nature is God. Nature is
always Neutral and balances everything. We should surrender to
Nature. Then, Nature will take care of us. No one is greater or stronger
than Nature.
Life is an endless journey. In this journey, seconds, minutes, hours, and
days run very fast. Years seem to finish in a month. We never think
about the times when everything was running smoothly without
disturbance. We never think about a time when we are happy. Then,
seconds became minutes, minutes became hours, hours turned into
days, days became months and months turn into years. Suddenly, if an
unpleasant disturbance should happen, the cycle of time changes into
reverse. In this unexpected situation, it becomes difficult for us to pass
our time.

pages.body:
Search me not in temples, mosques, or churches because I live so
close and near to you that I see through your eyes, hear through your
ears, speak through the mouth, walk through your legs, and guide all
through your heart and mind. I am the silent witness of your acts,
thoughts, and deeds. Be good to all, sincere, truthful, and love all
beings as you love your own self. Be humble and meek and give up
selfishness and ego. Thus, convert your own body into a holy temple
and install Me personally in your purified heart chamber. Surrender
to me with devotion so that I can reveal to you my true nature of
energy to protect and guide you at all places and at all times

pages.title: Dhanvantari · Felicitations to doctors — page 2
pages.alt: Dhanvantari · Felicitations to doctors, inside left, page 2
pages.body:
“Compare to compare but not to Conquer”
    In Indian tradition, doctors are revered as divine figures,
embodying the principle of “Vaidyo Narayano Hari” which
means, ‘ the doctor is a form of God on Earth’ Their noble role
is to console, heal, and provide loving care to all patients;
regardless of caste, creed, profession, or religion. From the
simplest worker to the highest leader, doctors show equal
compassion and dedication. Truly, their work can be
compared to divine incarnations who always dedicate
themselves to the service of humanity.
    Dr K. Chadra Shekar, became the monk 
H.H Sri Vidyanarayana Thirtha, in 1975
and is from the Sri Shankara order. He is
now celebrating his Golden Jubilee,
marking 50 years of his spiritual journey.
To honour the selfless service of doctors,
Sri Vidyanarayana Thirtha wishes to
present a small memento, recognizing
every doctor’s commitment to the healing
profession across Ayurveda, Homeopathy,
Siddha, Allopathy, and other medical
fields.
“Doctors lead the noblest life on Earth”
 
 
I pray to Lord Dhanvantari to bestow his choicest
blessings on all doctors for their immense
contributions to the health and well-being of
humanity.

pages.title: Dhanvantari · Felicitations to doctors — page 3
pages.alt: Dhanvantari · Felicitations to doctors, inside right, page 3
pages.body:
Swamiji’s journey into spirituality began after a tragic
personal loss. After completing his medical studies, he
experienced a day of profound sorrow, losing four from his
family (father, mother, grandfather, and grandmother) on
the same day, and witnessed the last rites. This life-altering
event deepened his understanding of the delicate line
between life and death and the power of living and non-
living cells, guiding him to embrace the spiritual path.
    We all begin life as a single cell and ultimately return to
that same Unity. In between, we add, multiply, expand,
and divide, and eventually, we go back to where we
started. That is the mystic power of divinity. 
|| H H Sri Sri Sri Vidyanarayana Thirtha Swaminaha ||
With Choicest Blessings from
“Embrace the living cells 
and let go of the non-living”
Medical Camp for a better Vision , C.K. Palya, Dec 2022

Om Namah Shivaya Gurave Satchidananda Murtaye,
Nishprapanchaya Shantaya Niralambaya Tejase.
Agynanamulaharanam Janmakarmanivaranam,
Jnanavairagya Siddhyartham Guroh Padodakam Pibet.
Nityam Suddham Nirabhasam Nirakaram Niranjanam,
Nityabodham Chidanandam Gurum Brahma Namamyaham.
Nidhaye Sarva Vidyanaam Bhishaje Bhavaroginam,
Gurave Sarvalokanam Dakshinamurtaye Namah.
Om Namo Brahmadibhyo Brahmavidya Sampradaya-Kartribhyo Vamsarishibhyo Mahadbhyo, 
Namo Gurubhyah Sarvopaplavarahitah Prajnanaghanah Pratyagartho Brahmaivahamasmi.
Om Naraayanam Padmabhavam Vasishtam, Saktim Cha Tatputra Parasaram Cha,
Vyasam Sukam Gaudapadam Mahantam, Govindayogindra Mathasya Shishyam.
Sri Sankarachaaryamathasya, Padmapadam Cha Hastamalakamcha Shishyam,
Tam Trotakam Vartikakaramanyan, Asmadgurun Santatamanatosmi.
Srutismritipurananam Alayam Karunalayam,
Namami Bhagavadpadam Shankaram Lokasankaram.
Sankaram Sankaracharyam Kesavam Baadarayanam,
Sutrabhashya Kritau Vande Bhagavantau Punah Punah.
Isvaro Gururatmeti Murtibhedhavibhagine,
Vyomavad Vyapta Dehaya Dakshinamurthaye Namah.
Sri Vidya Narayana Tirtham, Sadyojatam Shivam Gurum,
Gynana Shakti Prasadityam, Badri Shankaram Vande Gurum.
Mangalam Vasudevaya, Mangalam Nanda Sunave,
Mangalam Partha Sudaya, Gitacharyaya Mangalam.
Shubham Karoti Kalyanam, Aarogyam Dhana Sampadah,
Shatru Buddhi Vinashaya, Deepa Jyotir Namostute.
Sri Mata, Jaya Mata, Jai Jai Mata. (3 times)
Om Jaya Jaya Shankara, Hara Hara Shankara. (5 times)
Brahmanandam Parama Sukhadam Kevalam Jnanamurtim
Dvandvathitam Gaganasadrisham Tatvamsyadi Lakshyam,
Ekam Nityam Vimalamachalam Sarvadhee Sakshibhutam
Bhavatitam Trigunarahitam Sad Gurum Tam Namami.
Yasyantarnadimadhyam Na Hi Karacharanam Namagotram Na Sutram
No Jatirnaiva Varnam Na Bhavati Purusho No Napumsam Na Cha Stri,
Nakaram No Vikaram Na Hi Janimaranam Nasti Punyam Na Papam
No Tattvam Tatvamekam Sahajasamarasam Sad Gurum Tam Namami.
Gururbrahma Gururvishnur Gururdevo Mahesvarah,
Guruh Sakshat Parambrahma Tasmai Shri Gurave Namah.
Chaitanyam Shashvatam Shantam Vyomatitam Niranjanam,
Nadabindukalatitam Tasmai Shri Gurave Namah.
Agynana Timirandhasya Jnananjana Shalakaya,
Chakshurunmilitam Yena Tasmai Shri Gurave Namah.
Akhandamandalakaram Vyaptam Yena Characharam,
Tatpadam Darshitam Yena Tasmai Shri Gurave Namah.
Sthavaram Jangamam Vyaptam Yat Kinchit Sacharacharam,
Tvampadam Darshitam Yena Tasmai Shri Gurave Namah.
Chinmayam Vyapitam Sarvam Trailokyam Sacharacharam,
Asitvam Darshitam Yena Tasmai Shri Gurave Namah.
Yatsatyena Jagat Sarvam Yat Prakashena Bhanti Yat,
Yadanandena Nandanti Tasmai Shri Gurave Namah.
Na Guroradhikam Tatvam Na Guroradhikam Tapah,
Na Guroradhikam Jnanam Tasmai Shri Gurave Namah.
Gurureko Jagat Sarvam Brahma Vishnu Shivatmakam,
Guroh Paratharam Nasti Tasmat Sampujayet Gurum.
Yasya Deve Parabhaktih Yatha Deve Tathagurau,
Tasyaite Kathita Hyarthah Prakashante Mahatmanah.
Mannathah Shrijagannathah Madguruh Srijagadguruh,
Mamatma Sarvabhutatma Tasmai Shri Gurave Namah.
Dhyanamulam Gurormurtih Pujamulam Guroh Padam,
Mantramulam Gurorvakyam Mokshamulam Guroh Kripa.
Twameva Mata Cha Pita Twameva, Twameva Bandhu Cha Sakha Twameva
Twameva Vidya Dravinam Twameva, Twameva Sarvam Mama Deva Deva
Anyatha sharnam nasti | Tvameva sharanam mama||
Tasmad karunya bhavena | Raksha raksha gurudeva ||

pages.title: Search me not in temples…
pages.alt: Original photographed card headed Swamiji’s Message, beginning Search me not in temples, mosques or in churches.
pages.body: Search me not in temples, mosques or in churches, because I live so close and near to you that, I see through your eyes, hear through your ears, speak through mouth, walk through legs, guide all through your heart and mind. I am the silent witness of your acts, thoughts and deeds. Be good to all, sincere, truthful and love all beings, as you love your own self. Be humble, meek and give up selfishness and ego. Thus convert your own body into a holy temple and install Me personally in your purified heart chamber. Surrender to me with devotion, so that, I can reveal to you my true nature of energy to protect and guide you at all places and at all times.
